name: Apple
story: Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak and Ronald Wayne started out selling the Apple I computer, built in the Jobs family garage.

name: Google
story: Stanford PhD students Larry Page and Sergey Brin turned a research project on search into a company, run from a rented garage.

name: Microsoft
story: Bill Gates and Paul Allen started by writing a BASIC interpreter for the Altair 8800 home computer.

name: Amazon
story: Jeff Bezos started selling books online from his garage.

name: Meta (Facebook)
story: Mark Zuckerberg launched TheFacebook for Harvard students from his dorm room.

name: Netflix
story: Reed Hastings and Marc Randolph started by renting DVDs by mail.

name: Spotify
story: Daniel Ek and Martin Lorentzon set out to build a legal alternative to music piracy.

name: ByteDance (TikTok)
story: Zhang Yiming founded ByteDance; TikTok later launched as the international version of Douyin.

name: Alibaba
story: Jack Ma and 17 co-founders started an online marketplace from his apartment.

name: Samsung
story: Lee Byung-chul started Samsung as a small trading company selling dried fish, vegetables and noodles.

name: Sony
story: Masaru Ibuka and Akio Morita began with a radio repair shop in a damaged department store after the war.

name: Nintendo
story: Fusajiro Yamauchi started out making hanafuda playing cards by hand.

name: SAP
story: Five former IBM employees set out to build standard software for running a business.

name: Shopify
story: Tobias Lütke built an online store to sell snowboards, then turned its software into the product.

name: Airbnb
story: Brian Chesky and Joe Gebbia rented air mattresses in their apartment to cover the rent during a design conference.

name: Uber
story: Travis Kalanick and Garrett Camp started with an app for booking black cars.

name: WhatsApp
story: Former Yahoo engineers Jan Koum and Brian Acton built an app for status updates that became a messenger.

name: Booking.com
story: Geert-Jan Bruinsma started Bookings.nl, a small site for booking hotels online.

name: Adyen
story: Pieter van der Does and Arnout Schuijff built one payments platform to replace patched-together systems.

name: Revolut
story: Nik Storonsky and Vlad Yatsenko started with a card that made spending abroad cheaper.

name: Wise
story: Kristo Käärmann and Taavet Hinrikus were tired of hidden fees when moving money between Estonia and the UK.

name: Klarna
story: Three Stockholm School of Economics students built a simpler way to pay online.

name: Atlassian
story: Mike Cannon-Brookes and Scott Farquhar started with a credit-card loan and built Jira.

name: Mercado Libre
story: Marcos Galperin wrote the business plan while studying at Stanford, inspired by eBay.

name: Nubank
story: David Vélez started a digital bank to cut the fees and paperwork of Brazilian banking.

name: Grab
story: Anthony Tan and Tan Hooi Ling turned a Harvard business plan into MyTeksi, a taxi-booking app.

name: Flipkart
story: Former Amazon employees Sachin and Binny Bansal started by selling books online.

name: Tesla
story: Martin Eberhard and Marc Tarpenning set out to prove electric cars could be desirable; Elon Musk joined as lead investor.

name: OpenAI
story: Founded as a non-profit AI research lab by a group including Sam Altman, Greg Brockman, Ilya Sutskever and Elon Musk.

name: Anthropic
story: Founded by former OpenAI researchers, including Dario and Daniela Amodei, to focus on AI safety.

name: Discord
story: Jason Citron and Stanislav Vishnevskiy built a voice and text chat app for gamers.

name: Zoom
story: Eric Yuan, a former Cisco Webex engineer, set out to make video meetings easier to use.

name: LinkedIn
story: Reid Hoffman and his co-founders started a professional network from his living room.

name: Snapchat
story: Stanford students Evan Spiegel and Bobby Murphy built an app for photos that disappear.

name: Reddit
story: Steve Huffman and Alexis Ohanian started it straight after college, with funding from Y Combinator.

name: X (Twitter)
story: It started as a side project inside the podcast company Odeo, with Jack Dorsey, Biz Stone, Evan Williams and Noah Glass.

name: Tencent
story: Pony Ma and his co-founders started with the QQ instant messenger.

name: Huawei
story: Ren Zhengfei began by reselling telephone switches imported from Hong Kong.

name: Xiaomi
story: Lei Jun and his co-founders started with MIUI phone software before making phones.

name: Yandex
story: Arkady Volozh and Ilya Segalovich built a search engine designed for the Russian language.

name: Duolingo
story: Luis von Ahn and Severin Hacker, at Carnegie Mellon, set out to make language learning free.

name: Stripe
story: Irish brothers Patrick and John Collison wanted to make online payments simple for developers.

name: Bolt
story: Markus Villig, then 19, started Taxify with a loan from his family.

name: Deliveroo
story: Will Shu started out delivering restaurant meals himself.

name: ASML
story: Started as a joint venture between Philips and ASM International to build chipmaking machines.

name: Philips
story: Gerard Philips and his father Frederik started out making light bulbs.

name: Nokia
story: Fredrik Idestam founded it as a paper mill.

name: Ericsson
story: Lars Magnus Ericsson opened a telegraph repair workshop.

name: Shein
story: Chris Xu started an online wedding-dress business that grew into fast fashion.

name: Odoo
story: Fabien Pinckaers started TinyERP, open-source software for running a business.
